changes.reason: OSS-PUBLIC-CLIENT-PKCE-OPTION (2026-10-10, owner decision): new rule PKCE-REQUIRED-DEFAULT-1. PKCE is required for every public client unless an org_admin turns pkce_required off for that one client; the default is on, an opted-out public client may omit the challenge but a sent challenge is still S256-only and verified, confidential clients are unchanged, and dynamic registration cannot turn it off.

OSS-PUBLIC-CLIENT-PKCE-OPTION item 0a (review OSS-FIXES-REVIEW-2026-10-10 R1): new rule FRONTCHANNEL-SANDBOX-ORIGIN-1. A front-channel logout frame gets allow-same-origin only when the receiver's canonical browser origin is positively different from the issuer's; a zero-padded default port, an IDNA alias or an alternative IPv6 spelling of the issuer's origin gets allow-scripts alone.
